system.description: Ten minutes, a candle and a silver coin are all you need to read a stranger. Test Presence (DR12). Triumph: they tell you a secret they have never told anyone, and think kindly of you. Success: they answer one question honestly, believing the cards asked it. Failure: they pay, shrug and leave. Ruin: you tell them something true that you should not know. They think you a witch, and the Candle-Wicked Men may hear of it.
